# Primary Property Solutions from Kinsale


## **Get to Know Primary & Ground-Up Property at Kinsale**


##### **Up to $12.5M Commercial Property limits • 24 Hours typical submission reply time • As low as $500 Small Property deductible**


You may know Kinsale for Excess Property. Our Commercial Property and Small Property teams also deliver **fast, flexible primary and ground-up solutions** for a wide range of risks, from simple to complex.


### **A Quick Look at Our Primary and Ground-Up Solutions**


#### **Commercial Property**


- Up to $12.5M limits, kept in-house
- Ground-up: 100% limits up to $12.5M TIV
- Primary: up to $50M TIV
- Primary quota share: lead or follow-form up to $250M TIV
- All Risk, DIC & Single Peril forms
- CAT-exposure: wind, wildfire, EQ & flood
- [Explore our Commercial Property Appetite](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/property/commercial-property/#target-classes)


#### **Small Property**


- Ground-up: up to $5.5M TIV
- Deductibles from $500
- $1,000 minimum premium
- All Risk & Single Peril
- Cannabis, daycares, offices, vacant buildings, & much more
- [Explore our Small Property Appetite](https://www.kinsaleins.com/products/property/small-property/#target-classes)


**Send us your next primary or ground-up property risk.** Our underwriters reply quickly, and if the first quote isn’t where you need it, we’ll work with you to get it right.
